scope: Source-derived Enatega profile address management via genuine customer-owned backend
ownership: apps/customer-web only including BFF and UI; independent tests QA owner
source: Pinned Enatega profile addresses/main/address-listings and address component structure; preserve provenance/license
transport: GET /api/customer/addresses returns allowlisted own records; cache no-store
POST /api/customer/addresses fixed action create/update/delete/select; exact allowed shape action/id/input, no client tokens/userId/roles/selected
Reuse existing exported endpoint/sameOrigin/names/boundedJson/BoundaryError for input/CSRF/cookies; bounded dedicated backend response parser up to524288bytes for50addresses,8sec timeout no redirect
Read access from existing HttpOnly cookie; backend CUSTOMER-bound facade owns authorization; never return/store bearer tokens
Backend bounded codes map to401/403/404/409/400/503; malformedbackendJSON ->503; no SQL/PII logs
ui: List/create/edit/delete/select server-backed records; accessible unique names/live region/forms and keyboard Enter
Manual label/address/details/longitude/latitude fields; maps/geocoding unavailable honestly no coordinate defaults guessed
Busy disables affected actions and prevents duplicate submissions; final list reread after mutations
Loggedout signin link; empty real state; expiredsession/outage show bounded honest feedback
Preserve existing identity/catalog routes and scoped styles; do not new dependency/root locks
Profile link from account; no whole upstream provider tree initialization
acceptance: Cross-customer ID injection denial and state preservation; foreign/missing origin rejects mutations
No browser tokens localStorage/sessionStorage or returned JSON; no upstreamrequests
owner_rule: Complete original Enatega UI only; source-derived replacement screens prohibited. Backend evidence retained.
